referee_caveats_inferred: Merger identification is visual and partly subjective; no blind or independent re-classification test is reported
Major/minor split relies on the Ks-band flux ratio, which at z~5.5 is below the Balmer break and a poor mass proxy
Only 9 of 23 mergers have a Ks ratio; the 0.88 factor comes from 8 sources
Mixing literature pair fractions with different selections may bias the evolution fit
Many downstream numbers (R_MM, rho_MM) are dominated by the choice of T_MM
